find:
if (selfTest === null) return;
    const text = selfTest.report();
killedBy: the self-test body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1013) Copy pressed before the body loaded throws nothing and writes nothing
why: Issue #1013. Copy pressed before the self-test's body has loaded calls `report()` on a view that does not exist and throws from the click listener. jsdom reports that as a window `error` event rather than a throw from `click()`, which is what the test listens for.
